ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area comprising approximately 85-90% of the visible fluke, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters making up the remaining 10-15%, primarily associated with scarring and distal encrustations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated high-contrast white mottling in the medial-lateral quadrant of the left lobe; discrete, isolated white linear and circular clusters on the right lobe; high-intensity clusters localized at the extreme distal margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch vertex is well-defined and sharp.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; the left trailing edge features deep, irregular excisions near the distal tip; the right trailing edge shows more consistent, lower-amplitude peaks and valleys along the medial boundary transitioning to jagged irregularities distally.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve on both lobes, sweeping upward and outward to sharp, irregular distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-intensity pixel groups located at the distal tips and along the anterior margins; several isolated circular white marks (diameter 10-20 pixels) scattered across the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Complex network of intersecting white linear marks on the left lobe; distinct, near-parallel vertical/diagonal linear disruptions on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme jagged irregularities and potential tissue loss at the distal tips; extensive rake marks and scarring coverage across both ventral lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-contrast pixel clusters along the extreme outer edges indicating heavy biological encrustation; notable asymmetry in the serration pattern between the left and right lobe trailing edges.
